top_signals.title: Trump Says Putin to Supply US With Diesel
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are ProShares' Alessio De Longis, Flexport's Ryan Peterson, Raymond James & Associates' Inc Savanthi Syth, Council of Economic Advisers former Chair Jared Bernstein, Wealth Enhancement Group's Ayako Yoshioka, CFRA's Ken Leon, Atomic Machines CEO Jeff Holden, MoffettNathanson's Nick Del Deo. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
